Definition: treatment, i.e. an act (of good or ill); by implication, service or requital
BiblicalUsage: gᵉmûwl means dealing, recompense, benefit. It occurs 17 times in all, and the passages I have picked — Judges, 2 Chronicles, Psalms, and Proverbs — show it in its plain sense. I read it as a word that does its work quietly, without dressing anything up.
TheologicalSignificance: What gᵉmûwl tells me is that God speaks plainly, and plain words carry real weight. I hold that reading it plainly keeps me honest about what God actually said.
RelatedEvents: Abimelech's Rise and Fall; Hezekiah and Sennacherib's Invasion
